name: Jindal Steel
about: Jindal Steel and Power (JSP) is one of India’s foremost industrial groups, with a strong presence in steel, mining, power generation, and infrastructure development. Operating across India, Africa, and Australia, JSP is recognized as a global leader in its industries. Led by Naveen Jindal, the company focuses on innovation and sustainability, offering a wide range of products across the steel value chain, including sponge iron, pellets, and castings. JSP also generates power through its dedicated power segment. Committed to supporting India’s "Make in India" initiative, JSP is dedicated to advancing self-reliance and enhancing lives through its diverse portfolio.
